summary: Five qualifying Phoenix retail sale comps (0.8–1.72 miles) were selected within the 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31 window, 24,000–31,200 sf. Considerations normalize to $9.60M–$12.48M and prices to ~$400–$433 per sf. Duplicates (R1958/R5005) were deduped; unsigned and post-cutoff updates were ignored; an executed amendment before cutoff (U-R9866-1) was applied. A comps XLSX with citations has been created.
limitations: Assumes sources published after 2026-08-31 (e.g., S-R6730) are excluded even if event dates qualify.
No adjustments for tenancy, credit, capex, or location beyond distance; unit pricing is unadjusted.
Per-sf calculations assume reported sf is accurate; rounding to two decimals may cause minimal differences.
Deduplication relied on matching entity_id; other duplicates (if any) may remain undetected.
